4. Poisson algebras
The aim of this section is to prove that the categories Pois1 of unitary Poisson
algebras and CPois1 of unitary commutative Poisson algebras over a ﬁeld F with
charpFq ‰ 2 are action representable.
We recall that a Poisson algebra is a vector space X over F equipped with two
bilinear multiplications
¨: X ˆ X Ñ X
and
r´, ´s: X ˆ X Ñ X

identity holds:
